about.title: About This Showcase
content: This is an industrial-grade smart manufacturing management system designed specifically for the mold industry, integrating core functions such as production scheduling, real-time monitoring, and data analysis.
The project adopts modern frontend technology stack, focusing on user experience and system performance, successfully helping factories improve production efficiency and optimize resource allocation.

production.title: Production Management - Manufacturing Execution System
production.description:
As the frontend engineer for this project, I was responsible for visualizing complex production management workflows and managing scheduling and cost analysis for **39 injection molding machines** across the facility.

**My Core Contributions**:
1. **[Smart Scheduling System](#system-Smart Scheduling)**: Customized the open-source `vis-timeline` Gantt chart with **840+ lines of industrial-grade code** to support real-time scheduling management across 4 production areas. Utilized `useRef` to prevent unnecessary re-renders, `useMemo` for data optimization, and implemented view center preservation.
2. **[Internal Quote System](#system-Internal Quote System)**: Led complex form development using **React Hook Form + Zod** to handle multi-process cost calculations (molding/post-processing/inspection). Modularized calculation logic into dedicated Hooks and managed form state with Zustand to ensure real-time formula accuracy.
3. **UI/UX Design & Implementation**: Due to limited design resources, I proactively took on interface design for the "[Smart Cost Analysis](#system-Smart Cost Analysis)" and "[Smart Scheduling](#system-Smart Scheduling)" systems, participating throughout client requirement interviews to ensure features met operational needs.
4. **ERP Data Integration**: Collaborated with backend teams to integrate order, mold, and part number data from the Lingyue ERP system using RTK Query for API state management and automatic caching.

🔗 **[View Project - Smart Scheduling System](#route:/wise-scheduling)**

qualityControl.title: Quality Control - Inspection Management System
qualityControl.description:
Developed a **paperless inspection system** for the quality control department to ensure data integrity and traceability.

**Technical Implementation Highlights**:
1. **Dual Authentication Architecture**: Implemented segregated verification workflows for QC personnel and production supervisors using React Router's nested routing design (`/:machineSN/:userType/dashboard`), ensuring all inspection records are traceable to specific operators.
2. **Dynamic Form System**: Developed dynamic forms supporting "First Article", "Last Article", and "IPQC Patrol" inspections using **React Hook Form + Zod**, with real-time data submission to establish comprehensive digital quality records.
3. **Layered Architecture Design**: Separated business logic (domain), UI (components), and state management (hooks) to improve code maintainability.

sales.title: Sales Department - Quote Management System
sales.description:
Developed a professional customer-facing quote system integrating customer management, order tracking, and quote history queries.

**Technical Features**:
1. **Shared Architecture with Internal Quote System**: Reused component library (ProcessCostAnalysis, ProcessForms, ProfitDashboard) while separating business logic through independent service layers (salesServices vs factoryServices). Sales system emphasizes profit display, while internal system focuses on process details.
2. **Unified Calculation Logic**: Used `ComputationUtilsV1.js` to ensure frontend-backend calculation consistency, with **Zod** for data validation.
3. **Intuitive User Interface**: Built consistent design system using Material-UI + styled-components to help sales teams generate quotes quickly and reduce customer response time.

manufacturing.title: Manufacturing Department - Production Execution System
manufacturing.description:
Developed comprehensive production execution tools for on-site personnel, covering equipment maintenance, machine status monitoring, performance dashboards, real-time production tracking, and facility-wide utilization analysis.

**Core Technical Implementation**:
1. **Machine Status Management (Three-Layer Validation Architecture)**:
   - UI Layer: StatusSlider provides frontend real-time validation
   - Business Layer: useStatusManager Hook handles business logic
   - Validator Layer: statusValidator ensures state transition rules (RUN/IDLE/TUNING/TESTING/OFFLINE)
   Utilized `forwardRef` and `useImperativeHandle` to allow parent component control over form submission timing.
2. **[Facility Performance Dashboard](#system-Performance Dashboard)**: **Fully self-designed and developed**. With no design resources available, I independently completed UI/UX design, technology selection, and implementation. Researched and selected open-source packages `@iimm/data-view-react` + **ECharts** to integrate **5 subsystems** ([Performance Dashboard](#system-Performance Dashboard), Real-time OEE, [Production Progress Tracking](#system-Production Progress Tracking), Delivery Trends, OEE Insights) for full-screen data visualization. Received high praise from management and clients after demo. Implemented temporary style mechanism with automatic cleanup on component unmount to prevent interference with other pages.
3. **[Maintenance System](#system-Machine Maintenance)**: Used Zustand for header parameter state management and RTK Query for API handling, implementing unified drawer state management with three-level approval workflow (Inspector/Re-inspector/Approver). Also includes [Mold Maintenance](#system-Mold Maintenance) and [Comprehensive Maintenance](#system-Comprehensive Maintenance) systems.
4. **Production Tracking**: Includes [Dispatch System](#system-Dispatch System) and [Machine Status & Maintenance Records](#system-Machine Status Operations), using multi-layer Context Provider architecture to manage complex state (ProductionRecordProvider, ProcMaterialsProvider, etc.) with Redux Slice for feature state separation.

🔗 **[View Project - Facility Performance Dashboard](#route:/ManufacturingLiveMonitor)**

portfolio.title: Personal Portfolio Website
portfolio.description:
This portfolio website is itself a complete frontend project, demonstrating my continuous technical skill development after leaving my previous position.

**Technical Highlights**:
1. **Internationalization (i18n) Implementation**: Integrated **i18next + react-i18next** to enable Traditional Chinese/English bilingual switching, using namespace architecture to organize translation files, HTTP backend for dynamic language resource loading, and browser language detector for automatic user language detection.
2. **Design System (Design Tokens)**: Established a comprehensive design token system defining colors, spacing, typography, borders, shadows, and other design specifications to ensure visual consistency across the entire site.
3. **Responsive Design**: Utilized **Material-UI + Styled-Components** dual styling system, with MUI handling complex UI components and Styled-Components managing global theming and responsive utilities.
4. **Modern Development Toolchain**: Adopted **Vite** build tool, **React Router v6** for routing management, and **React Hook Form + Zod** for form validation.
5. **Deployment & CI/CD**: Deployed on **Cloudflare Pages** with integrated GitHub Actions for automated deployment workflows.

This project demonstrates my comprehensive understanding of frontend engineering, from architecture design, UI/UX implementation, internationalization support, to automated deployment capabilities.
